World Time Database

We are the trusted time resource for many of the biggest corporations and companies around the world! Our database is self-hosted option so you don't have to rely on API's or another company's server for accurate time zone info. We have maintained our database for over 20 years!

What Time Is It? - A new way to look at time around the world! Get real time answers to interesting time related questions.

Time Zone Converter

Pick the one exact place and exact time your event will occur and we'll give you a link to email or post on your website. Everyone who follows the link gets to pick their home location to compare their time directly with yours. No big list of world cities to distract anyone, no math required.
